programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S33/E1 - Season Of Citrus'. The hosts celebrate seasonal citrus with brightened-up winter dishes. The menu includes pan roasted salmon with blood orange sauce and bucatini al limone.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S52/E11 - Seeking A Sous-Chef: Battle 3'. Four more chefs try to score the chance to work as a judge's sous-chef. Offal is an awfully shocking surprise, and a cut of meat proves problematic.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Porch Party Pies'. Zoë bakes up a table full of irresistible pies and one of her favourite desserts for a porch party with her loved ones, as they welcome spring back to Minnesota.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Buzzworthy Bakes'. Zoë bakes her dad a beehive-shaped birthday cake with a variety of honey she picked up from a farm visit. Plus, she whips up some doughnuts with a honey glaze.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Cookie Delivery'. Zoë wants to give her youngest son a taste of home while he's away at college. She bakes him delicious chocolate chip cookies and a variety of brownies.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Apple Classics'. Zoë kicks off apple season by visiting an orchard and picking new varieties to put a twist on her apple Bundt cake. She also whips up a few childhood favourites.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Decorating Cakes'. Zoë surprises her best friend by making a devil's food cake topped with champagne buttercream. She also shares her top tips for piping roses and borders.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Coffee Break'. Zoë visits a local bakery and finds inspiration for a new twist on her cinnamon braid. Then, she makes a cardamom pear cake and enjoys both with an old friend.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S27/E4 - DDD Summer Games, Part 2: Extreme Tailgating'. Guy continues the games with a 'Flavortown 500' race with remote-controlled cars to see which chef gets first pick of the ingredients.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E8 - Taste Of The Tropics'. Guy tucks into lobster enchiladas and lionfish rolls at a waterside restaurant in Florida. Plus, he chows down on Vietnamese sandwiches and spring rolls.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E9 - Mouthwatering Meats'. Guy travels to Houston, Texas, to visit a restaurant that's serving worldwide recipes all under one roof, like Latin-style pork belly and Caribbean oxtails.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S1/E11 - Cake Stakes'. Four bakers must create fantastic cakes in record time. In round one they must adapt quickly. Then they uncover a jumbo-sized ingredient in the second basket.

programme.title: Chef Dynasty: House Of Fang
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Fully Booked'. Kathy and her team work double shifts to cover a tech convention that brings thousands of people into Fang. All three floors of the restaurant open for the first time.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Emily Blunt'. Ina is joined by friend Emily Blunt for a day of cooking and conversation. Ina welcomes her guest with classic English cream scones and Emily makes turkey Bolognese.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S38/E12 - Food Court Favorites'. The hosts are making the most nostalgic treats from the food court, including pizza dough pretzels, lo mein and chili cheese fries.

programme.title: Chopped

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
